name: glm-terminal
label: GLM Terminal / Agent Runtime
description: Production-supported runtime adapter for GLM-based terminal workflows. Reuses AIKit core with workspace install/update flow, canonical memory and adapter-specific continuation launchers.

graph_execution.purpose: GLM runtime can inspect packaged workflow DAG metadata and graph-aware handoff hints from the installed workspace.

runtime_entrypoints.name: glm-runtime-guide
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-specific AIKit instructions for GLM workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: continue-maintainer
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Continue developing AIKit inside GLM using the maintainer handoff prompt.

runtime_entrypoints.name: packaged-agents
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Canonical maintainer agent packaged for GLM runtime.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-operating-protocol
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Rules for GLM agents to choose internal AIKit tools, memory updates and RAG refreshes without exposing scripts as the primary user interface.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-continuation-contract
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Rules for resumed flows, bundle handoff, session lineage and next-step orchestration in GLM workspaces.

runtime_entrypoints.name: runtime-tools-registry
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Machine-readable registry of internal AIKit tools GLM agents can use for orchestration, memory, RAG and validation.

runtime_entrypoints.name: mcp-tool-plane
runtime_entrypoints.purpose: Runtime-native MCP provider matrix for GLM agents, keeping Figma/GitHub tools separate from local shell commands.
